There are many reasons to give thanks this year:
We’ve survived another year
We’re alive, despite the odds.
Perhaps you’ve noticed that life hasn’t always been easy
But at least we still have each other.
For which I am most thankful.
For my family, my friends,
My coworkers,
my agent,
and especially you.
Not alone my mother,
who makes this possible.
For without her, I would surely perish.
May we all flourish and find happiness.

Poetry Monday: The Dogs Are Howling
November 26, 2019 / By
The dogs are howling,
Barking loud and long.
It’s been a trying year,
But I’m thankful I’m strong.
The turkeys are flying South,
With their heads cut off.
So let us feast and drink our fill.
For we’re all in this together.
And may the spirits guide us well.
Let freedom ring from every hill and every tree.
